lean_statement:
theorem hasDirichletDensity_chebotarevSet (C : Set Gal(L/K))
    (hC : ∀ σ ∈ C, ∀ τ : Gal(L/K), τ * σ * τ⁻¹ ∈ C) :
    (chebotarevSet C).HasDirichletDensity (Nat.card C / Nat.card Gal(L/K))
title: Chebotarev for conjugacy-stable sets
assumptions: K and L number fields, with an algebra structure making L/K Galois.
C is invariant under conjugation by every element of Gal(L/K).
quantifiers: For every Galois extension of number fields and every subset C of its Galois group satisfying conjugation invariance.
The set of primes has Dirichlet density |C|/|Gal(L/K)|.
interpretation: Among the unramified primes, the primes whose Frobenius lies in a chosen union of conjugacy classes have Dirichlet density equal to the fraction of group elements in that union.
human_review: Pilot statement reading and focused comparison

comparisons.title: Chebotarev density, class field theory course
comparisons.finding: The standard Dirichlet-density theorem for a conjugacy class extends by finite disjoint union. The corpus states the union form.

comparisons.title: CBirkbeck/chebotarev-density at c64095e
comparisons.finding: The corpus quantifies over all conjugacy-stable sets, including a single class. The external header states the single-class version and its proof at this revision is sorry. A finite additivity bridge would recover the union form.
